name: ArcticTradeLanes Atlas Agent
description: Arctic GIS OSINT for the Northern Sea Route and the Polar Silk Road: ports, lanes, vessels, programmes, shipyards and industry sites on an EPSG:3996 polar map. Live today: free atlas lookups (GeoJSON downloads and static fact pages in 22 languages) and the paid NSR route-optimize HTTP endpoint (legacy x402 v1, 5 USDC on Base, or a free tier of 10 runs per day per IP). Planned and not live yet (ATL MVP spec, Phase 3): an A2A JSON-RPC endpoint at https://api.arctictradelanes.com/a2a, a remote MCP server at https://mcp.arctictradelanes.com/mcp, x402 v2 paid lane comparison and agent registration.

extensions.description: Legacy x402 v1 (custom x402-payment request header) on POST /api/alpha/route-optimize and /api/x402/*: 5 USDC on Base. Discovery document: https://arctictradelanes.com/.well-known/x402.json. x402 v2 is planned, not live.

skills.name: Atlas object lookup
skills.description: Free facts for 1,316 Arctic atlas objects (ports, programmes, cities, shipyards, industry, airports, rail, lanes, tankers, icebreakers, rescue centres). Live: static fact pages /port/{slug}, /program/{slug}, /shipyard/{slug}, /industry/{slug}, /lane/{slug}, /vessel/{slug} and more, in 22 languages; /object/{atlas_id} redirects to the typed page; layer indexes such as /ports; bulk GeoJSON at /atlas.4326.geojson and /atlas.3996.geojson.
examples: Facts for ARC-PORT-001 (Murmansk Commercial Sea Port)
List the Arctic ports in Norway

skills.name: NSR vs Suez lane comparison
skills.description: Live today: free lane records (typical distance, transit days, ice conditions, icebreaker escort, transit fee) for 27 Arctic shipping lanes in the lanes layer (/lanes and /lane/{slug}). Planned, not live: computed NSR vs Suez/Cape comparison at POST https://api.arctictradelanes.com/v1/lanes/compare (x402 v2, 0.05 USD).
examples: Compare typical distance and transit days of the Northern Sea Route sections

skills.name: NSR route optimisation
skills.description: Live: POST https://arctictradelanes.com/api/alpha/route-optimize. Paid via legacy x402 v1 (5 USDC on Base, payTo 0x211D91beD006f7bB3Eaf97496260a8F905298Cea) or the free tier (10 runs per day per IP). Status: GET https://arctictradelanes.com/api/alpha/status.
examples: Optimise a Murmansk to Busan voyage via the Northern Sea Route in August
